704.description: Console I/O demonstration: read n, then n sorted integers, then target. Print the zero-based index of target, or -1 if it is absent.

167.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers sorted in non-decreasing order. Line 3: target. Print the 1-based indices i j (i < j) of the two numbers that add up to target, separated by a space. Exactly one solution exists.

125.description: Console I/O. Line 1: the string s (it may contain spaces and punctuation). Print true if s is a palindrome after keeping only alphanumeric characters and ignoring case, otherwise false.

test_cases.input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

26.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers sorted in non-decreasing order. Print k, the number of unique elements, on the first line and the k unique elements in order on the second line.

643.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers. Line 3: k. Print the maximum average of any contiguous subarray of length k, with exactly 5 decimal places.

3.description: Console I/O. Line 1: the string s (letters, digits, symbols; no spaces). Print the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

217.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers. Print true if any value appears at least twice, otherwise false.

242.description: Console I/O. Line 1: string s. Line 2: string t. Print true if t is an anagram of s, otherwise false.

20.description: Console I/O. Line 1: a string containing only the characters ()[]{}. Print true if the brackets are valid (every opening bracket is closed by the same type in the correct order), otherwise false.

121.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (prices by day). Print the maximum profit from buying on one day and selling on a later day, or 0 if no profit is possible.

70.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n (1 <= n <= 45). Print the number of distinct ways to climb n stairs taking 1 or 2 steps at a time.

198.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (money in each house). Print the maximum amount that can be robbed without robbing two adjacent houses.

322.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (coin denominations). Line 3: amount. Print the fewest coins needed to make the amount, or -1 if it cannot be made.

1046.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (stone weights). Repeatedly smash the two heaviest stones (equal: both destroyed; otherwise the difference remains). Print the weight of the last remaining stone, or 0 if none remain.

55.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (maximum jump length at each index). Print true if the last index can be reached starting from index 0, otherwise false.

209.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (positive). Line 3: target. Print the minimal length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least target, or 0 if none exists.

739.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (daily temperatures). Print n space-separated integers: for each day, the number of days until a warmer temperature, or 0 if there is none.

238.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers. Print n space-separated integers where the i-th value is the product of all elements except the i-th. Do not use division.

35.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers sorted with distinct values. Line 3: target. Print the index of target if present, otherwise the index where it would be inserted to keep the order.

350.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n integers (nums1). Line 3: m. Line 4: m integers (nums2). Print the intersection with each element appearing as many times as it occurs in both arrays, in ascending order, space-separated.

876.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (linked list values in order). Print the values from the middle node to the end, space-separated. With two middle nodes, start from the second.

206.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (linked list values in order; n may be 0). Print the values of the reversed list, space-separated.

875.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (banana piles). Line 3: h (hours). Print the minimum integer eating speed k such that all piles can be finished within h hours.

33.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (a sorted array of distinct values rotated at an unknown pivot). Line 3: target. Print the index of target, or -1 if it is absent.

34.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers sorted in non-decreasing order (n may be 0). Line 3: target. Print the first and last index of target separated by a space, or -1 -1 if it is absent.

560.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers. Line 3: k. Print the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals k.

11.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (line heights). Print the maximum amount of water a container formed by two lines can hold.

150.description: Console I/O. Line 1: the tokens of a Reverse Polish Notation expression separated by spaces (integers and the operators + - * /; division truncates toward zero). Print the evaluated integer.

128.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (unsorted). Print the length of the longest run of consecutive integer values.

21.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n sorted integers (list1). Line 3: m. Line 4: m sorted integers (list2). n or m may be 0 with an empty line. Print the merged sorted list, space-separated.

141.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (linked list values). Line 3: pos, the zero-based index the tail links back to, or -1 for no cycle. Print true if the list has a cycle, otherwise false.

19.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (linked list values). Line 3: k. Remove the k-th node from the end and print the remaining values, space-separated (an empty line if none remain).

567.description: Console I/O. Line 1: s1. Line 2: s2. Print true if s2 contains a permutation of s1 as a substring, otherwise false.

76.description: Console I/O. Line 1: s. Line 2: t. Print the minimum window substring of s that contains every character of t (with multiplicity), or an empty line if no such window exists. The answer is unique.

416.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers (positive). Print true if the array can be partitioned into two subsets with equal sums, otherwise false.

215.description: Console I/O. Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers. Line 3: k. Print the k-th largest element.

200.description: Console I/O. Line 1: rows cols. Then rows lines, each a string of cols characters that are 0 (water) or 1 (land). Print the number of islands (groups of land connected horizontally or vertically).
